title: Close benchmark credibility gaps
description: Implement the remaining contract, Cloudflare optimization, live verification, and publication hygiene gaps for the Workers framework benchmark plan.

title: Execute Cloudflare framework optimization audit controls
description: Implement the optimization ideas from the GitHub research pass as repeatable benchmark controls: Worker bundle/startup checks, server/client boundary leak scans, prefetch mode disclosure, asset/route caching disclosure, compatibility flag disclosure, and chart/media hydration risk reporting.
design: Keep this as static/reproducible controls first, not app-by-app tuning, to avoid mutating benchmark semantics and existing dirty app changes.
acceptance_criteria: A repo script reports optimization risks per app; package scripts expose the audit; static verification runs the audit; docs describe the controls and upstream rationale; tests cover the audit.
close_reason: Implemented Cloudflare benchmark control audit, wired static verification, updated docs, and verified with pnpm verify:static.
